```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vars)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
```


```{r}
# Load the dataset
data <- read_csv("economic_data_2000_2019.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
data$date <- as.Date(data$date)

#simplify
data <- data[,c("Real_GDP", "CPI_Inflation", "WTI_Crude_Oil_Prices", "date")]

# Remove missing values
data <- na.omit(data)
```

```{r}
png('data_ts.png')

# Step 1: Exploratory Analysis
data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

ggplot(data_long, aes(x = date, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol=1) +
  labs(title = "Time Series of Variables", x = "Date", y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none")

# Prepare data for VAR analysis
var_data <- data %>% dplyr::select(-date)
```

Here we will end up with a $(3 \times 7)$ coefficient matrix: 3 rows, 1 for each variable; 7 columns correspond to the intercept plus the 2 lags for each variable.

```{r}
# Step 2: Create a time series object for VAR model
ts_data <- ts(var_data, start = c(2000, 1), frequency = 4)

# test for stationarity
acf(ts_data[,1])
acf(ts_data[,2])
acf(ts_data[,3])

# Step 3: Fit VAR(2) Model
var_model_2 <- VAR(ts_data, p = 2, type = "const")
```


```{r}
# Step 4: Covariance Matrix of Residuals
cov_matrix <- cov(residuals(var_model_2), use = "complete.obs")
print(cov_matrix)
```


```{r}
# Step 5: Impulse Responses (IRFs)
irf <- irf(var_model_2, impulse = colnames(var_data), response = colnames(var_data), n.ahead = 10, boot = TRUE, ortho = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Step 6: Plot IRFs
png('IRF.png')

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot_irf <- function(irf_result, impulse, response) {
  irf_data <- as.data.frame(irf_result$irf[[impulse]])
  ci_lower <- as.data.frame(irf_result$Lower[[impulse]])
  ci_upper <- as.data.frame(irf_result$Upper[[impulse]])
  
  df <- tibble(
    time = 1:nrow(irf_data),
    irf = irf_data[[response]],
    ci_lower = ci_lower[[response]],
    ci_upper = ci_upper[[response]]
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = irf), color = "dodgerblue4") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.3, fill = "gray") +
    labs(
      title = paste(impulse, "on", response),
      x = "Horizon (Quarters)",
      y = "Response"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dotted", color = "black") +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(axis.title=element_text(size=6), plot.title=element_text(size=8))
}

for (impulse in colnames(var_data)) {
  for (response in colnames(var_data)) {
    nam <- paste0("p_",impulse,"_",response)
    assign(nam, plot_irf(irf, impulse, response))
  }
}

plotlist <- lapply(ls(pattern="p_"), get)
marrangeGrob(plotlist, nrow = 3, ncol = 3, top = NULL)
```

```{r}
# Step 8: Orthogonal Impulse Responses (OIRs)
oirf <- irf(var_model_2, impulse = colnames(var_data), response = colnames(var_data), n.ahead = 10, boot = TRUE, ortho = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# only repeating this function definition to change color
png('OIRF.png')

plot_irf <- function(irf_result, impulse, response) {
  irf_data <- as.data.frame(irf_result$irf[[impulse]])
  ci_lower <- as.data.frame(irf_result$Lower[[impulse]])
  ci_upper <- as.data.frame(irf_result$Upper[[impulse]])
  
  df <- tibble(
    time = 1:nrow(irf_data),
    irf = irf_data[[response]],
    ci_lower = ci_lower[[response]],
    ci_upper = ci_upper[[response]]
  )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = irf), color = "dodgerblue4") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.3, fill = "gray") +
    labs(
      title = paste(impulse, "on", response),
      x = "Horizon (Quarters)",
      y = "Response"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dotted", color = "black") +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(axis.title=element_text(size=6), plot.title=element_text(size=8))
}

for (impulse in colnames(var_data)) {
  for (response in colnames(var_data)) {
    nam <- paste0("p2_",impulse,"_",response)
    assign(nam, plot_irf(oirf, impulse, response))
  }
}

plotlist2 <- lapply(ls(pattern="p2_"), get)
marrangeGrob(plotlist2, nrow = 3, ncol = 3, top = NULL)
```

```{r}
#table 1: coefficient matrix of VAR(2)
coeffmat <- coef(var_model_2)
coeffmat

write.csv(coeffmat, "coefficients.csv")
```


```{r}
#table 2: variance-covariance matrix Sigma:
model_summary <- summary(var_model_2)

# Obtain variance-covariance matrix
cat("Covariance matrix of residuals:\n")
print(model_summary$covres)
cat("Correlation matrix of residuals:\n")
print(model_summary$corres)
```

```{r}
#table 3: Cholesky Decomposition of Sigma
cholesky <-t(chol(model_summary$covres))
```

```{r}
write.csv(model_summary$covres, "covariance.csv")
write.csv(cholesky, "cholesky.csv")
```



```{r}
#plot: FEVD
fdecomp <- fevd(var_model_2)
plot(fdecomp)
```

```{r}
#alt plot FEVD using ggplot:
png('FEVD.png')

dat <- map_df(fdecomp, ~as.data.frame(.x), .id="id") %>%
    mutate(horizon = rep(1:10, 3)) %>%
    pivot_longer(names_to = "var", cols = c(WTI_Crude_Oil_Prices, CPI_Inflation, Real_GDP))
#head(dat)

ggplot(data = dat, mapping = aes(x = horizon, y = value, fill = var)) +
  facet_wrap(~id, nrow=3, ncol=1) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ylab("Proportion")
```
